#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int lenA = a.size(), lenB = b.size();
    int need = lenA + lenB - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < need) size <<= 1;

    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < lenA; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        ai[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < lenB; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        bi[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    transform(ar, ai, false);
    transform(br, bi, false);

    vector<double> cr(size, 0.0), ci(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> dr(size, 0.0), di(size, 0.0);

    double factor = 0.25 / size;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);

        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

        cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        dr[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        di[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    transform(cr, ci, true);
    transform(dr, di, true);

    vector<int> result(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long p1 = llround(cr[i]);
        long long p2 = llround(dr[i]);
        long long p3 = llround(ci[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((p1 + ((p2 % mod) << 15) + ((p3 % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

void transform(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_reversebits((unsigned)i) >> (32 - bits);
        if (i < j) {
            double t = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = t;
            t = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = t;
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTable(half);
        vector<double> sinTable(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double cr = cosTable[j];
                double ci = sinTable[j];
                double ur = re[i + j];
                double ui = im[i + j];
                double vr = re[i + j + half] * cr - im[i + j + half] * ci;
                double vi = re[i + j + half] * ci + im[i + j + half] * cr;

                re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                re[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                im[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& input;
    char buffer[1024];
    int index, total;

public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : input(is) {
        index = 0;
        total = 0;
    }

    int get() {
        if (total == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        if (index >= total) {
            index = 0;
            input.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            total = input.gcount();
            if (total <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[index++] & 0xff;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c;
        while ((c = get()) <= ' ') {
            if (c == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        }
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = get(); }
        int num = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
            num = num * 10 + c - '0';
            c = get();
        } while (c > ' ');
        return num * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx = in.nextInt();
        poly[idx] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> res = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            res = multiply(res, poly, MOD);
        }
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }

    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : res) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;

    return 0;
}
